big_case.notes: Emergency application by the President, through the Solicitor General, to stay lower-court injunctions against an executive order restructuring federal election administration, granted by the full Court roughly ten weeks before the 2026 midterms over heavy adverse amicus participation. Among the highest-stakes interim matters on the docket: separation of powers, federal-state control of elections, and immediate electoral consequences.
